2017: The first CBA banner went up while Patrick Czechut went 0-3 through the Punishment Bracket. Team Buddha lost the final assignment game to Jason Nitz, 84.42-64.16, establishing a tradition from the opposite end of the standings.
2018: Brandon Hansen entered the Punishment Bracket at 4-9 and then made absolutely sure there was no confusion about the final result. The 2018 Nebraska Huskers went 0-3 and closed with a 115.44-3.10 loss to Wes Dempsey.
2019: While Peter Ganz was collecting the championship, Alex Continenza was completing a different bracket run. Chief Slappinhoes went 0-3 in punishment play and lost the final matchup to Ben Christianson, 85.50-68.56.
2020: Shawn Smith began his Hall of Shame résumé with an efficient 0-3 trip through the Punishment Bracket. Post Mahomes finished the job with a 116.56-102.72 loss to Jack Haley.
2021: Cody Stalp successfully navigated the one bracket where winning was strongly recommended and chose the alternative. The Nebraska Huskers went 0-3, ending with a 104.10-83.22 loss to Shawn Smith.
2022: Shawn Smith returned to familiar territory and added a second Stupidest Loser finish. Vanilla Gorilla went 0-3 in punishment play before Austin Ketter closed the file, 115.48-102.58.
2023: The championship earned Kelbey Heider another banner. Jack Haley earned the assignment nobody hangs from the rafters. A Nu Start went 0-3 in the Punishment Bracket and lost the final to Austin Ketter, 101.04-67.10.
2024: Shawn Smith briefly attempted an escape with a first-round win, then corrected course with two straight losses. Big Swiftie Guy lost the final punishment matchup to Peter Ganz, 94.60-92.12, giving Shawn a league-record third Stupidest Loser finish.
2025: Cody Leslie finished 7-7 and still found the one postseason path where going 0-3 had consequences. Punani Dasani lost the final punishment matchup to Peter Ganz, 7.90-1.10, while the championship bracket handled the banner business elsewhere.
